Subject: Requesting permission: Aurelia co-marketing quote & badge for success story

Hi Alyssa / Miguel —

Hope you’re both well. We’re preparing a short joint success story to highlight how Aurelia Health reduced inference costs and improved latency on patient intake flows using Redwood Inference. We’d love to include: 1) a one-sentence customer quote from someone on the product/ops side, and 2) Aurelia’s logo/badge on the case study landing page and sales one-pager.

Attached is a one-pager draft and a proposed short quote for review. If this is of interest, would you please:
- Confirm who should sign off on logo usage (marketing/comms or legal)
- Tell us any constraints (approved colors, do-not-use variants, timeframe)
- Share the preferred high-res logo (if you’d rather we request it from your assets repo)

We can limit usage to the website and sales collateral only; we’ll not issue any press release or broader announcement without explicit permission.

Attachments: Aurelia_OnePager.pdf (draft), proposed-quote.txt

Thanks — looking forward to your guidance.

Best,
